ticket.summary: Garbage disposal hums but won't spin (suspected jam); customer is attempting approved DIY flywheel-freeing steps first, tentative 9/1 10:30am slot offered if it fails.
mitigation_advice: Never reach into the disposal, even when off [PB-07]
Unplug the unit or switch off its breaker before touching it [PB-07]
Remove visible objects with tongs or pliers [PB-07]
Use the hex/Allen socket under the unit to rock the flywheel free, then restore power and press the red reset button [PB-07]

quote_lines.description: Garbage disposal jam clearing (only if DIY attempt fails)

ticket.customer_message: You've got this. Make sure it's fully unplugged before anything goes in there, and rock the Allen key both directions — jams usually pop free with a bit of back and forth [PB-07]. Don't forget the red reset button underneath before you test it. If it still hums or won't restart, text me back and I'll grab you tomorrow's 10:30am slot for the $99 jam clearing (no after-hours charge). Otherwise, enjoy the win!
